narr: A cluster of thunderstorms formed over Ohio during the late afternoon and early evening hours of July 24th, as weak disturbances aloft sparked convection in an unstable atmosphere. The slow-moving storms impacted Coshocton County most keenly with wind damage and flash flooding.
ev: Many roads were reported to be flooded in Coshocton.
Numerous county and state roads were closed due to flooding, including SR-83 and SR-93.
lsr: Sheriff's office reporting numerous county and state roads closed due to flooding...including SR-83 and SR-93.
